local_review.finding_body: The contribution rewrote a test class file to preview bytecode and added --enable-preview to the JVM and Native Image solely for that test, violating the native flag necessity rule in FS-test-contract.2.7 because the need originated in test code rather than AspectJ. It also removed the existing generated-concrete-aspect behavior from ClassLoaderWeavingAdaptorTest instead of preserving that meaningful behavior, violating the no-weakening repair rule in FS-test-contract.2.9.
local_review.finding_title: Test-created native flag and weakened runtime coverage
local_review.fix_note: Removed the preview-bytecode rewrite and --enable-preview flags, restored the version-agnostic ASM rejection assertion, and restored generated-concrete-aspect initialization using NativeImageSupport.runToleratingUnsupportedFeature for its runtime class-definition path. Forge finalization regenerated the affected statistics.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the full contribution diff and local gate evidence. Scope is limited to org.aspectj:aspectjweaver:1.9.21.1, the index validation record is green, and only reachability-metadata.json is used. The repaired dynamic-access reports pass every ordered comparison: overall 155/156 (99.359%) to 153/157 (97.4522%), reflection 140/140 (100%) to 137/140 (97.8571%), and resources 15/16 (93.75%) to 16/17 (94.1176%). The exact Forge finalization command then passed all three native lanes, metadata and style checks, generated-test validation, and statistics generation without further publishable changes.
